LineCraft
Review launcher source
Local-first writing control room

Write with AI.
Keep your hands on the wheel.

LineCraft turns rough context into polished writing, then lets you highlight, compare, and refine exactly what matters. Your projects stay in your browser.

Launch LineCraft

curl -fsSL https://ojas-singh.github.io/linecraft/launcher.mjs | node --input-type=module

Requires Node.js 18+. The launcher opens LineCraft automatically; keep its terminal open while writing.

1

Copy one command

No repository, npm install, build, account, or desktop installer.

2

Run it locally

A tiny Node launcher binds only to 127.0.0.1 and opens your browser.

3

Start writing

The current app loads from GitHub while AI requests use the same local origin.

Natural editor

Write in a continuous document and highlight any passage for focused alternatives.

Visible changes

Hover suggestions to preview additions and removals directly in your document.

Local projects

Drafts, style profiles, history, and feedback remain in browser storage.

Know what you run. Piping a remote script into Node executes code on your computer. LineCraft’s launcher uses only Node built-ins, binds to loopback, and can be reviewed here before running.

Troubleshooting

Check the launcher with curl http://127.0.0.1:8787/health. If port 8787 belongs to another process, inspect it with lsof -nP -iTCP:8787 -sTCP:LISTEN, stop it intentionally, then run the launcher again.
